scope: Core-only research; no new extension functions. Taffy means standard Taffy Cuckoo, not all Taffy variants. Paths normalized for portability. RSS is whole-process high-water mark after construction, before probes and standalone serialization; Taffy bytes are resident structure sizes, others payload sizes. The partitioned build counts child payloads only. Times are single-threaded, build includes generating hashes but probes exclude hash generation. No retained input array in main comparison. Radix results have a known UBSan failure and are provisional. Diagnostic freeze fixes are only in an external source copy.
